# Retrospective, PR #12973

## Worked
Fresh verified native Opus 5.5 High and Sol Xhigh sessions independently found matching mechanisms. Source-only Sol assessment and a narrow native offscreen Opus experiment complemented each other. Coordinator read complete reports, raw material evidence and fixture code, then requested an audit addendum rather than accepting sealed-run banners. Public findings remain narrower than the most expansive reviewer wording. No desktop resources, upstream publication or browser opening occurred.

## Deviations retained
- Opus used ls -la once, causing incidental ownership-name resolution despite explicit numeric-only instruction.
- A qml6 GUI version probe aborted despite core limit zero. Potential external host crash-handler record was not queried; aborted probe excluded.
- qs-v1 result parser and extraction pipelines did not gate every producer; run_qs did not compare expected child status. Sentinel Error could count as completion and its status was not recorded.
- clone-v1 returned success on expected-status mismatch and used any for two cases. Upstream mktemp used isolated /tmp outside declared /tmp/work, and cleanup removed internal stubs/call logs. Outer child streams survived.
- Several final write targets were built from private roots but not individually resolved/asserted. Original fully-guarded statements were corrected in audit-addendum.md without deleting history.
- Read-only discovery/path guesses failed harmlessly: unsupported herdr context; background path guess; Sol absent base blob with lazy fetching disabled. None used as technical evidence.

## Corrections required for future fixtures
These reinforce, rather than replace, existing workflow requirements. Before execution, enumerate each transitive callee, final write target and status producer. Assert each final resolved target including log redirection, result, sentinel, summary and done files. Set upstream TMPDIR to an asserted assignment-private root and adapt cleanup to preserve evidence before invoking tests. Return failure immediately on unexpected child status or missing/invalid result. Record pipeline producer statuses independently; do not accept last-stage success. Require and record native sentinel Ready, never merely non-Loading. Prefer non-GUI version probes; set a supported isolated platform before any GUI probe and do not assume core limit zero alone excludes pipe-based crash handling. Use numeric metadata only. Do not run additional substitute tests absent an unresolved conclusion-changing question.

Coordinator passed these corrections back in the audit request and retained the response. Further tests were not needed: raw native results already establish the narrow duplicate and traversal observations, source substantiates the mechanism, and unavailable compositor scope remains explicit. Do not characterize these runs as fully guarded or safety-process compliant.

## Cleanup and independence
Four foreground review.py receipts completed; native children have recorded exits and no timeout status. Private PID namespaces end with their owned runners. No global process scan or pattern kill used. No allocated nests, background jobs or runtime resources remain. Reviewer panes preserved idle. Technical reports saved before any audit follow-up; no peer report was supplied to either independent reviewer. No quota exhaustion observed.
comment:
Two service-loader issues were found at `2ff6664c`: duplicate instances during asynchronous loading, and manifest-controlled access to the host object tree.

## Track pending service loads before starting another

In [`ensureService()`](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/2ff6664c54675c7890c5391669ca3c50a5e4b1d6/shell/shell.qml#L890-L949), a `Loading` component leaves no pending marker. A registry scan emits `pluginsChanged()` and then `scanFinished()`, both of which can call `_syncServices()` before compilation finishes:

```text
first sync  -> start load A -> service map still empty
second sync -> start load B -> service map still empty
Ready A/B   -> create twice -> map retains only the last instance
                              earlier host-parented instance remains alive
```

**Verified:** With the extracted base/head loader in Quickshell 0.3.1, synthetic services and a modeled two-sync scan completion, four services produced four instances on base and eight on head. The head retained both instances of each first-party service under `serviceHost`.

**Impact:** Repeated synchronization during compilation can leave duplicate service objects outside lifecycle cleanup. For the background service, that risks duplicate surfaces and work; actual desktop surfaces were not tested. A late callback also does not recheck whether the plugin was disabled or replaced while loading.

**Suggested change:** Claim each pending service ID before starting compilation, as `loadPluginWidget()` already does. Invalidate pending loads on disable/reload, and verify the current manifest, enabled state and load generation before creating or publishing an instance. Clear the pending claim on success and error.

## Do not grant host parenting from a self-declared clone name

The new [attachment rule](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/blob/2ff6664c54675c7890c5391669ca3c50a5e4b1d6/shell/shell.qml#L918-L921) accepts any `omarchy.clonedFrom` starting with `omarchy.`, including a nonexistent source. A third-party manifest can supply that field without passing through the clone command.

**Verified:** In the same synthetic QML check:

| Third-party service | Base | Head |
|---|---|---|
| No clone metadata | Detached | Detached |
| `clonedFrom: "omarchy.not-a-real-plugin"` | Detached | Parented to `serviceHost`; reached the host shell through a first-party sibling's `shell` property |

**Impact:** A service can bypass its scoped shell facade through the shared object tree. This is a service API-boundary regression, not a demonstrated credential leak or same-process sandbox escape: authentication services remain detached, and plugin code is already unsandboxed.

**Suggested change:** Keep third-party services detached unless the required integration can be granted through host-controlled state or a narrow API. A user-editable clone-name prefix is not provenance. The reported component-load error occurs before `createObject()`, so parenting alone does not explain that error.

---

## Review information

**Test scope:** Source review and isolated offscreen Quickshell checks using the extracted production loader, synthetic services and modeled registry callbacks. No Wayland compositor, real background surface, or original `No such file or directory` reproduction was tested; an end-to-end fix for that symptom remains unverified.

**Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Automated AI review:** Astra Medium performed initial inspection and synthesis; Opus 5.5 High and GPT 6 Sol Xhigh completed independent technical assessments. Claims were checked against source and targeted evidence, followed by a fresh Astra Medium editorial check.
